title: Justin Trudeau spotted at Katy Perry's Lifetimes Tour after dinner date sparks rumors - NewsBreak
text: Former Prime Minister of Canada Justin Trudeau was spotted at Katy Perry' s Lifetimes Tour , just after the pair were seen out to dinner together in Montreal. The pop star was performing at the city's Bell Centre on July 30, when fans spotted Trudeau in the crowd, dancing along to the concert. Someone snagged a photo of the politician, which quickly went viral among her fans at home. One fan wrote: "Oh yeah, that's 10000% her man," followed by laughing emojis. "Oh he must love her," another speculated, noting the two have spent two nights this week together. Just two nights prior, Perry and Trudeau were spotted at Montreal's Le Violon, a high-end French restaurant tucked away in Montreal's Le Plateau. In paparazzi photos from the outing, the pair appear to be engaged in one another as they converse while leaning across the table. A source who claimed to have also been at the restaurant reported to TMZ that the pair had cocktails and shared several dishes. They also shared that Perry and Trudeau went to the back of the kitchen to greet the chef and thank the staff for the meal. Their security guards reportedly stayed nearby at the bar. The dinner date followed Katy and her ex-fiance Orlando announcing their breakup earlier this month. The split came after considerable rumors about their romance, including reports that the couple had been planning "make-or-break talks" during a "rough patch." Spokespeople for Katy and Orlando - who co-parent four year old daughter Daisy Dove Bloom - later released a joint statement regarding their rumored breakup. The statement confirmed they had parted ways, with their relationship now focused on raising their child together. The statement read, "Due to the abundance of recent interest and conversation surrounding Orlando Bloom and Katy Perry's relationship, representatives have confirmed that Orlando and Katy have been shifting their relationship over the past many months to focus on coparenting. "They will continue to be seen together as a family, as their shared priority is - and always will be - raising their daughter with love, stability and mutual respect." The pair, who share 4-year-old daughter Daisy Dove , ended their nine-year relationship . They had been engaged for the past six years and had to cancel their original wedding date due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Shortly after calling it quits, Bloom was spotted riding solo at Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez's wedding. Perry was set to attend the event, but couldn't make it due to conflicts with her tour.
